title: wsutil: More -Wsign-conversion issues
description:
Some of things are casting inherently unsigned objects that are
signed in POSIX for historical reasons (e.g., blksize_t). The
number of arguments when spawning a command in ws_pipe also must
be unsigned. g_get_monotonic_time returns a signed 64-bit integer
for some reason.
